construction: Materialize rational Pascal rows n=0..2k, width k+1. Each row uses a stored previous row with two charged reads and one charged add per nonzero column; base literals 0/1. Materialize factorials r=0..k using charged successor-index embedding and multiplication. Each source entry reads cached row k+i-r, binomial column k, factorial r; charged division and accumulated addition. No Nat.choose or factorial computation appears in executable producer bodies; they occur only in correctness specifications.
operation_model: Inherited StoredGivens Run, tick and collect. Rational field add/multiply/divide and Nat-to-Rat successor embedding cost one field tick. Reads and two-pass collect traffic charged. Natural index arithmetic, index branches, recursion control and counter bookkeeping outside this scalar/word model. Every nonconstant rational arithmetic operation in the producer is charged. Integer bitlength, GCD reduction, allocation internals, physical runtime and finite-bit circuit compilation are NOT bounded.
